summary.headline: Alivus Q1 FY27 revenue rose 6.4% YoY to INR640 crores as non-GPL grew 26.5%, offsetting a 52.6% GPL drop; EBITDA margin 36.6%.

financial_highlights.metric: Cash and cash equivalents incl. short-term investments

financial_highlights.value: CVS and CNS 58% of top line; chronic therapies 74% of top line

segments.name: GPL business
segments.commentary: Revenue fell 52.6% YoY in Q1 due to inventory rationalization after a strong Q4; management expects flattish growth in FY27 with H2-weighted performance. Customer base includes more than 50 commercial products.

segments.name: Non-GPL API business
segments.commentary: Grew 26.5% YoY on new launches and demand across geographies; constant-currency growth about 20%, with volume up about 21-22% and price down about 1-2%.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.commentary: Grew 3.8% YoY in Q1; quarterly revenue about INR160-170 crores per management, lumpy by nature, with momentum expected in H2 from newly added projects. Active discussions on about 7 projects; current revenue from 5 projects.

qa_highlights.question: Is 60% gross margin sustainable, and how much of the improvement is process versus launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited launches and operational efficiency as the two drivers; launch margins will not drop off sharply, and second-gen processes and ongoing efficiency gains should hold margins near 60% barring a quarter here or there.

qa_highlights.question: Why guide EBITDA margin only 30-32% when Q1 was 36.6%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it could guide to 34%, but is being cautious due to war-driven raw material price increases; Q1 margin of 36.6% could fall to around 34% in steady state if GPL recovers.

qa_highlights.question: What gives confidence in flat-to-growing GPL for FY27 after a 52.6% fall?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 is not indicative of the full year, with more than 50 commercial products supplied to a large, long-standing customer, and worst case is flattish growth.

qa_highlights.question: Solapur delay and capacity adequacy for double-digit growth in FY27-28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Ankleshwar and Dahej are on track, Solapur is slightly delayed due to labour slowdown, and existing capacity suffices as Solapur Phase 1 and 1.1 will be loaded with captive intermediates and ROW business.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company looking at acquisitions, and what are the criteria?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said capacity is not a constraint and it would not spend on facilities; it is looking at synergistic pipeline-led acquisitions from different platforms that add value to the API plus strategy.

qa_highlights.question: How many new CDMO customers and inquiries; expected margin trajectory?
qa_highlights.answer: Active discussions on about 7 projects, with current revenue from 5 projects; management did not give a numerical CDMO growth target and said margin improvement will come from a mix of CDMO and new API launches.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at 10% to 12%, skewed to H2 FY27.

EBITDA margin guided at 30% to 32%; management said it could reach about 34% if raw material pressure from the war situation eases, and that margin could settle near 34% in a steady state once GPL recovers.
GPL expected flattish in FY27 in the worst case, with a stronger H2 as in prior years.
Solapur expected operational in early Q3 FY27 (also referred to as by Diwali); regulatory inspection targeted within a year of start-up.
R&D intensity to settle at around 4% of revenue, mainly new API.
FY27 capex of approximately INR540 crores.
HP API patent-expiry-linked launches to start around end of calendar 2027, with the bulk of projections in FY28.
capex_capacity: Solapur Phase 1 and 1.1 is a greenfield facility; slight delay, now expected operational in early Q3 FY27. Phase 3 deliberately deferred to avoid under-absorption.
Brownfield expansions at Dahej (about 160 KL) and Ankleshwar (about 110 KL) are on track for completion on schedule.
Taloja R&D centre construction has begun and is on schedule.

Solapur initially to be loaded with large-volume captive intermediates and a backward integration block; only ROW business to be serviced from Solapur for about a year until audited by FDA or a European agency.
Capex of INR85 crores in Q1 FY27; approximately INR540 crores planned for FY27.
demand_pricing: Non-GPL demand strong across all geographies, supported by recent launches gaining scale as patents expire at different times across markets.
Price decline of about 1-2% in non-GPL business; volume growth about 21-22% in constant currency terms.
Rupee depreciation benefited results as company is a net exporter; forex gains supported EBITDA margin.
Raw material prices rising since the war situation, starting with solvents and now moving to KSM; partial pass-through to customers achieved, with more frequent price discussions.
Management expects CDMO to grow faster than the overall business, with growth from 2 new projects and older projects returning.

617 DMF and CEP filings globally as of June 30; 29 high-potent API products in the active grid, with a total addressable market of $82 billion, of which 13 validated, 7 advanced and 9 in lab development.
risks_watch: Raw material cost inflation from the war situation (solvents, KSM) and extent of pass-through to customers.
Solapur start-up timing (early Q3 FY27) and subsequent regulatory inspection within a year; delays already seen.
GPL recovery in H2 FY27; Q1 GPL down 52.6% and dependence on a single large customer.
Lumpy CDMO revenue; quarterly variance and reliance on 2 new projects kicking in during H2.
Rupee-driven forex gains supporting margins may not persist.
Rising inventory build and working capital as the company covers raw materials at predetermined prices.
key_quotes: There's no point giving you a higher guidance and then not delivering. As a company, we've been always conservative.
So we don't want to hurry it up, just have a large, like Phase 3, you said.
So we don't want to do a 1 plus 1 is equal to 2. We'd rather have a 1 plus 1 equal to 3 or 4.
Q1 is not an indicator of how the year will go.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and margin delivery, but deliberately conservative on guidance, explicitly citing war-related raw material risk and Solapur timing slippage. Answers on GPL and CDMO were more qualitative, with few hard numbers beyond the stated ranges.

adds.what: Solapur greenfield facility (Phase 1 and 1.1), slight delay
Taloja R&D centre (construction begun, on schedule)

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided at 10-12% (midpoint 11%), skewed to H2, backed by non-GPL growth of 26.5% and CDMO pipeline, partly offset by GPL flattish outlook; Solapur slipped slightly to early Q3 FY27 and Solapur Phase 3 deferred.
